defs.tiers: ADP is the floor: T1 to the ADP ladder's natural top break, T2 to ADP rank 15, T3 to 22, T4 to 30, T5 the rest among the top 44 by ADP or by projection (4-drafter nights 10/15/20/30); the projection moves a player up one tier when it puts him two or more tiers higher, never down; scratched players left out.
defs.score: How fast swap value drops down the order: minus the slope of each player's swap value (the window's real lineups that drafted a tier player, with him swapped into that slot, re-ranked in the real standings) on his place in the order. Positive: the order puts the better swaps first; near zero: the tier was close to even.
defs.units: rate points per place in the order (top-10% or top-1% rate of the swapped lineups, in percentage points)
defs.headline: Whole lists through the real pods (pod replay): my locked list, ADP's order, ETR's (PM) or our Proj's (AM); rates in points, vs_mine is that list minus mine; my_percentile: the median share of my list's replayed teams my real teams beat, 0-100.
defs.orders: adp: ADP; etr / proj: the projection rounded to whole points, ADP breaking ties; mine: my locked list's order; lev (T5): under 60% drafted first, by projection.
defs.split: won / lost / even: nights the first list or order came out ahead of the second, behind it, level (headline vs_mine: that list against mine; tier diffs: the first order's score against the second's).
defs.stakes: The pod replay's read for the tier: my list with my tier in the projection's order minus the same in ADP's order (my own tier lines), top-10% and top-1% points.
